title: QuadRF can spot drones and see WiFi through my wall
summary: Jeff Geerling reviews QuadRF, a software-defined radio tool that can detect drones and visualize WiFi signals through walls using RF (radio frequency) technology, demonstrating its capabilities for RF monitoring and security applications.
problem_solved: Provides the ability to detect and monitor drone activity and WiFi signals through physical barriers for security and RF analysis purposes.
why_valuable: It democratizes RF monitoring technology, making drone detection and wall-penetrating signal analysis accessible to hobbyists and security professionals alike.
